input: wc -c AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md decisions/*.md GLOSSARY.md REVIEW-CHECKLIST.md roadmap/README.md HISTORY.md TESTING-NOTES.md README.md 2>&1; ls; ls decisions roadmap roadmap/briefs .claude/skills

wc -c .claude/skills/*/SKILL.md HISTORY.md RUN-LEDGER.md SEAT-LEDGER.md roadmap/briefs/TEMPLATE.md roadmap/briefs/REVIEW-PROMPT.md roadmap/briefs/BRIEF-REVIEW-PROMPT.md CONTRIBUTING.md roadmap/TEST-SHAPE.md roadmap/LANGUAGE-RETROSPECTIVE-2026-11-09.md CLAUDE.md TESTING-NOTES.md CLI-REFERENCE.md MCP-REFERENCE.md tools/gate.sh tools/docs-check.sh

grep -rn -i "lock" crates/acquisition-verbs/src/refusal.rs crates/acquisition-verbs/src/fault.rs crates/acquisition-store/src/error.rs crates/acquisition-protocol/src 2>/dev/null | head -30; grep -rln -i "busy\|in use\|holds the lock\|world_locked\|lockfile\|flock" crates --include='*.rs' | head -20
grep -n -i "busy\|in use\|lock" crates/acquisition-store/src/world.rs | head -25; grep -n -i "lock" CLI-REFERENCE.md MCP-REFERENCE.md README.md | head
grep -rn "impl.*Display for LockError\|\"busy\"\|Busy =>\|kind: \"busy\|refused as busy" crates --include='*.rs' | head -15
grep -rln "held by another process" crates | head; grep -rn "ACQ_UPDATE_FIXTURES" AGENTS.md TESTING-NOTES.md decisions/*.md CONTRIBUTING.md README.md .claude/skills/*/SKILL.md | head

grep -n "held by another process" crates/acquisition-cli/tests/world.rs crates/acquisition-daemon/src/daemon/endpoint.rs; ls crates/acquisition-cli/tests | head -50; python3 -I tools/bothy.py pack --path crates/acquisition-store/src/world.rs | head -5

grep -ho "^- \*\*C[0-9]*" AGENTS.md decisions/*.md | tr -d '*- C' | sort -n | tail -3; grep -rn -i "next id\|new id\|takes a new id\|highest" AGENTS.md decisions/process.md tools/bothy.py tools/docs-check.sh | head
